sentences.text: In a retrospective analysis of 36 patients with symptomatic Moyamoya disease, researchers compared standard single-phase CT angiography, perfusion-derived images, and a new AI-generated 4D-CTA.
Image quality was assessed using technical metrics such as signal-to-noise ratio and contrast-to-noise ratio, alongside subjective scores.
The AI-assisted 4D-CTA demonstrated excellent agreement with the gold-standard DSA method for grading disease stage and good agreement when assessing collateral blood vessel development.
This technique enables detailed visualization of blood vessels at different phases without requiring extra radiation exposure.
The authors conclude that this method offers a rapid, noninvasive way to evaluate collateral circulation with accuracy similar to DSA, suggesting potential for routine use.
